# llms.txt

This is the Step It Up Strategies website.

## Website Purpose

Step It Up Strategies is a business management and consulting company specializing in restaurant, retail, and entertainment sectors. The company provides comprehensive business consulting services including operational strategy, financial management, menu engineering, and staff training.

## Site Structure

This is a single-page marketing/landing site built with TanStack Start, React, and Tailwind CSS. The site includes the following sections:

- **Hero**: Main value proposition and key statistics
- **Services**: 7 core service offerings (Restaurant Consulting, Retail Strategy, Entertainment Venues, Menu Creation, Beverage Programs, Kitchen Layout, Permitting & Licensing)
- **Expertise**: Team credentials and qualifications (Certified Sommeliers, Spirit Experts, Food & Beverage Directors, General Managers, Owner Operators)
- **Financial Services**: Accounting and controller capabilities
- **About/Philosophy**: Company philosophy and sectors served
- **Contact**: Contact form for inquiries

## Contact Information

Email: brian@stepitupstrategies.com

## Technologies

- Framework: TanStack Start with React 19
- Styling: Tailwind CSS 4
- Hosting: Netlify
- Language: TypeScript

## Sitemap

See `/sitemap.xml` for the complete site structure and page hierarchy.

## Form Submission

The site includes a contact form that submits to Netlify Forms. Form submissions are processed and forwarded to the business contact email.

## Accessibility

The site is built with semantic HTML, proper ARIA labels, and responsive design for all device sizes.
